references.text: The verse describes the actual dream image (the event) that Joseph interprets in the source verse as seven years of famine.
The description of the seven lean cows in the dream is the direct visual precursor to the interpretation of seven years of famine.
The description of the seven thin ears of grain is the second part of the dream interpreted as seven years of famine in the source verse.
This verse is part of the same dream sequence that provides context for the seven lean cows interpreted in the source verse.
The action where the lean cows devour the fat ones is the very image interpreted as seven years of famine.
